info.name: s23bucket
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the s23bucket API. Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner: requests depend on each other (tokens and ids are stored in collection variables by the test scripts).

File uploads use the files in test-files/. In Postman Desktop set Settings -> General -> Working directory to the folder this collection lives in, or re-select the files once.

item.name: 00 Auth
item.description: Registers two fresh users (A and B) and stores their tokens in collection variables. Every other request uses {{token}} (user A) via the collection's Bearer auth.

exec: // fresh users for every run, so the collection can be run again and again

item.name: Create folder with trailing slash parent
Folder with the same name as a file

exec: pm.test("entries have id, name, type, size, uploadDate", () => list.forEach(e => pm.expect(e).to.include.all.keys("id", "name", "type", "size", "uploadDate")));

item.name: Get folder by id (folders have no content)
Replace a file that doesn't exist
Renamed file is found under the new name

exec: pm.test("content survived the rename", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("hello s23bucket v2"));

item.name: Id stays the same after rename
Move into a file (not a folder)
Patch a folder (files only for now)
06 Isolation (user B)
item.description: Runs as user B ({{tokenB}}). B must not be able to see, change or delete anything of A's. 404, not 403.

item.name: B gets A's file by id
B gets A's file by path
B deletes A's file by id
B deletes A's file by path
